moa: DPP-4 inhibitor (sitagliptin) combined with a biguanide (metformin)
series_start_reason: First quarter the issuer prints a Janumet-only line is 2007Q2: the first-quarter 2007 release (filed 2007-04-19) has no Janumet row in any product table, and the second-quarter 2007 release (exhibit 99.2, NET PRODUCT SALES DETAIL) prints JANUMET for the quarter. Series is worldwide. Legacy Merck & Co., Inc. (CIK 64978) before its November 2009 merger with Schering-Plough; the surviving filer CIK 310158 from the 2009Q4 release onward.
notes: Scope: the product-table row labelled JANUMET (2007-2010 legacy NET PRODUCT SALES DETAIL, 2010+ quarterly product tables) whose first dollar column is worldwide; the release summary tables from 2011 headline JANUVIA/JANUMET combined and are not used. Janumet XR is not printed as a separate line in any release checked; whether the Janumet line includes Janumet XR is not stated in the tables and was not verified. 2014Q3 is taken from the 2014 quarterly columns of the 2014Q4 release because the 2014Q3 release prints only the combined Januvia/Janumet line. 2009Q4 is read from the quarterly data table in exhibit 99.2 of the 2009Q4 release (accession 0001193125-10-031545), which prints the four 2009 quarters. Quarters sum to the printed full year for 2014 (2,070 vs 2,071), 2015-2022, 2023 (1,178 vs 1,177), 2024 (934 vs 935) and 2025 (rounding only).
